\subsection{Selected semantic guard and product rows}
For each local producer retain
\[
 g_h=4(c_h+v_h)+10v_h+4hv_h+4h^2+8h+8.
\]
The two-stage literal scalar count includes two additional groups per
copied center and one endpoint-addition group per data pair:
\[
 G=N_c+2v(g_{28}+2\cdot28)=4793351472.
\]
These are local scalar charges; the recursive copied transformations
are already included in $s_c$. Set
\[
\begin{aligned}
 E&=64(W_c+m_c+G+1)^3=9696565176891520488192506033216,\\
 \mathcal E&=2GW_c^2+8s_c+4W_c+4+32m_c\\
           &=2771683137698171397039558468<E,\\
 B_{m guard}&=s_c+E,\qquad C_0=32m_cB_{m guard}^2.
\end{aligned}
\]
A completed $u$-axis child has coefficients in $2^{-u}\mathbb Z[i]$
and absolute row sum at most $2^u$. Its internal excess stays local;
other streams, including originals of active copies, are parked.
No return rounding or encoding change is performed. A copied input
has the same incoming magnitude/grid bound as its original, and its
completed output obeys the same semantic bound. Consequently, with
$f=\lfloor e/m_c\rfloor$,
\[
 A(e)\le A(756f)+s_cf+E\le2B_{m guard}e,
\]
using $2B_{m guard}(m_c-756)\ge s_c+E$ and the direct-leaf bound
$A(e)\le8e$. Prefix kernels, phases and normalization add the retained
$18e$, which is less than $C_0e-2B_{m guard}e$. Thus $C_1=1$,
with the fixed fine-grid precision proof of RaD/PR23 unchanged.

The actual least halving degrees and wire bitlengths are
\[
 (t_b,w_b)=(9,28),\qquad(t_c,w_c)=(20,30),
\]
where $m_j^{t_j}>2r_j^{t_j}$ for largest children $r_b=529,r_c=756$.
At width $e$ reserve the product
$Q=W_c^{D_c(e)}W_b^{D_b(e)}$, with
$D_j(e)=t_j\lceil\log_2e\rceil$. Its coefficient is
$9\cdot28+20\cdot30=852$, and
\[
 2000>\frac{51}{25}\,852.
\]
The sufficient stock is therefore $p^{2000}$, supplied by the retained

\subsection{Exact conditional assembly}
Use the analytic proof map in
\path{notes/structured-bulk-assembly.tex}: arbitrary-source routing
with active masking and paid repair scans; one rounded phase-cell
matrix with preserved period cuts and downward-weight error bounds;
persistent target halos, sequential overlap tapes and factor pages;
Baker--Harman--Pintz prime packing; and the retained exact-recovery
interface. Their full costs are unchanged. In particular the bulk
bound retains the terms
\[
 O\!\left(Tp\left[p^\tau\operatorname{polylog}p+
 d\operatorname{polylog}p+dp^\delta+w^2p^\delta+
 dw^2p^\delta/L\right]\right)+n^{o(1)},
\]
with $L=2^{\lceil8\log_2p\rceil}$,
$w^2=O(p^{1-r})$, and normalization exponent requiring
$\epsilon+r<1$. These arguments, not a change of arithmetic model,
justify the seven margins below.

\begin{theorem}[Conditional fixed-tape multiplication bound]
Under the retained analytic and fixed-tape interfaces of PR23/PR29
and the preceding proof map, the selected copied-center networks give
\[
 T(n)=O\!\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
 \boxed{\kappa=\frac{384569}{10000000000}=3.84569\times10^{-5}}.
\]
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
Take the strict finite savings $a=a_b=384599/10^{10}$ and
$b=a_c=717/10^7$, with $\tau=1-a$, $\sigma=1-b$, and put
\[
\begin{gathered}
 \eta=10^{-8},\quad\beta=\tfrac14,\quad q=a(1-2\eta),\quad
 c=q(1+\eta),\quad\epsilon=\frac{1-\eta}{1+c+q},\\
 \lambda'=1-q,\quad\lambda=(\tau+\lambda')/2,\quad
 g=\epsilon q,\quad r=(g+1-\epsilon)/2,\quad\delta=\eta/8.
\end{gathered}
\]
The stopped complex leaf saving $(1-\beta)b=53.775\times10^{-6}$
is strictly above $a$, so paid internal adapters use exponent $\tau$
and both layer exponents lie below $\lambda'$. The exact certificate
checks all 47 strict constraints of the retained semantic/bulk
composition, using the new literal scalar charge and product-row gap.
These include compact reservations, geometry, the linear guard,
$\epsilon+r<1$, phase-cell/band separation, prime packing, short-record
fallback and artificial-boundary allowances.

The seven final savings are
\[
 1-\epsilon(1+c),\quad a,\quad g,\quad a,\quad
 \min(1-\epsilon-\delta,r-\delta),\quad
 1-\epsilon-\delta,\quad\epsilon.
\]
Their minimum is exactly $g$ and the prefix margin equals $g+\eta$.
Exact rational comparison gives
\[
 g-\frac{384569}{10^{10}}>4.0746056580\times10^{-11}>0.
\]
These positive gaps absorb fixed logarithms. The all-size conclusion
retains constructive finite setup, descriptor and catalogue domination,
prime existence and analytic recovery as eventual thresholds. The
strict bit and complex moments, copied-stream recurrence contracts and
these assembly inequalities prove the claimed conditional bound.
\end{proof}
